baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلسَّمَآءِ at word 1 and بَنَىٰ at word 3 bind an overhead object to an act of construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky is an upper cover whose stability comes from joined components and settled supports. The oath therefore foregrounds an engineered, load-bearing enclosure rather than undifferentiated empty height.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the sky as an overhead cover and gives the mechanism its enclosing upper surface.
The branch supplies construction by joining parts and makes assembly the canopy's operative principle.
The ribs and house-posts branch supplies load-bearing supports and turns generic building into a stable frame.

changed_reading.before: The verse swears by the sky and states simply that it was built.
changed_reading.after: The verse swears by a joined and supported upper canopy, making the sky's sustained structure—not merely its existence—the object of attention.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal ٱلسَّمَآءِ is visibly overhead, while بَنَىٰ can name the constitution on which a thing is made.
baseline_models.mechanism: A raised outline becomes the visible body of an underlying constitution. Building is thus not only an event in the past but a made form that remains perceptible in the sky's profile.

activation_trace.role: The looming raised outline supplies the sky's perceptible profile and makes elevation visually legible.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies the visible body or upper form, sharpening the sky from location into embodied contour.
The built-form and constitution branch supplies the hidden organization expressed by that visible contour.

changed_reading.before: Building denotes the completed fabrication of an external object.
changed_reading.after: Building denotes the sky's continuing constitution as a visible body whose outline displays how it has been formed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping for س م و places the visible sky beside branches of و س م, while بَنَىٰ anchors the reading in made form.
baseline_models.mechanism: The built sky can function as an identifying mark: its organized form is not merely seen but read as evidence of a condition or source. This is a split-root activation, not a claim that the surface noun lexically means a mark.

activation_trace.role: The visible identifying mark supplies the artifact-like trace by which the sky becomes recognizable.
The sign read by discerning observation supplies the act of inference from the sky's visible organization.
The branch supplies a constituted form whose organization can carry the identifying sign.

changed_reading.before: The sky is an impressive constructed object.
changed_reading.after: The sky is also a constructed trace: an organized mark that invites inference from visible form to the agency or order behind it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلسَّمَآءِ carries a branch extending the overhead sky to cloud, rain, and rain-grown vegetation, while بَنَىٰ carries bodily growth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky's building is dynamic and outwardly productive: the upper cover releases rain that marks land with growth, and nourishment in turn builds living flesh. Construction becomes a vertical life-making process rather than a finished roof.

activation_trace.role: The sky-cover branch explicitly extends to cloud, rain, and rain-dependent vegetation, supplying the downward life-bearing flow.
The first rain marking earth with vegetation supplies visible growth as the sky's terrestrial imprint.
Food building flesh supplies the conversion of nourishment into living structure.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a completed architectural product.
changed_reading.after: The sky is a productive construction whose rain continues building life below and leaves growth as its visible mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assembled canopy becomes an operable light-envelope. Sun and moon occupy a sequence in which following, unveiling, and covering are recurrent modes; the sky's construction is experienced through controlled transitions rather than through static mass.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the envelope within which alternating visibility can operate.
Joined construction supplies an organized system rather than a sequence of unrelated appearances.
The sun and its brightness supply the primary luminous state of the system.
The moon and its celestial light supply a second luminous body within the same envelope.
Following and succession supply temporal linkage between luminous states.
Uncovering and appearance supply the system's revealing operation.
A cover rising over and concealing a thing supplies the complementary obscuring operation.

structural_cues: 91:1-4 place repeated oath clauses and celestial or temporal nouns immediately before the sky oath.
The verbs تَلَىٰهَا، جَلَّىٰهَا، and يَغْشَىٰهَا make a follow-reveal-cover sequence around recurring feminine pronouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two lights, succession, disclosure, covering, and parallel syntax; I supply the arrow that these are operating phases of the built sky. A live alternative is that they describe the sun independently and reveal nothing about the sky's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a fixed assembled canopy.
changed_reading.after: The sky is an operating envelope whose build becomes perceptible as it sequences light, unveiling, and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A split-root hill image spatializes the moon's following: the sky's raised outline becomes a profiled horizon along which a luminous follower appears to travel. The activation converts temporal succession into visible topography.

activation_trace.role: The raised outline visible from afar supplies the sky's horizon-like profile.
The moon and its light supply the moving visible figure traced against that profile.
The non-dominant mapped hill branch supplies an elevated contour on which following can be spatially pictured.

structural_cues: 91:2 predicates following of the moon immediately before 91:5 names the raised sky.
The same feminine pronoun links the visible motion to an antecedent carried through the opening sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moonlight, a following construction, a raised sky-outline, and the split hill image; I infer a horizon-path joining them. The materially live alternative is ordinary temporal succession with no topographic implication.

changed_reading.before: The sky's visible constitution is a broad elevated body.
changed_reading.after: The sky can also be seen as a built horizon-profile that makes celestial following spatially legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building above and spreading below are complementary operations. The sky is no longer an isolated edifice: its upper cover and the extended lower surface jointly produce the bounded interval in which life can stand, move, and be seen.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the upper boundary of the paired habitat.
Settled supports supply stability to the upper boundary rather than mere height.
The lower surface explicitly opposed to the sky supplies the complementary boundary.
Spreading and extension supply the horizontal operation paired with vertical construction.

structural_cues: 91:5 and 91:6 are adjacent syntactic twins: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا / وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا.
The lexical opposition of upper sky and lower earth is reinforced by different making verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper cover, a lower counterpart, building, spreading, and exact clause parallelism; I infer that the two operations co-produce a habitable span. The alternative is a pair of independent wonders with no functional enclosure between them.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a self-contained constructed roof.
changed_reading.after: The sky is the upper half of a coordinated habitat, built in relation to an earth deliberately spread beneath it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's built constitution becomes the cosmic member of a scale analogy. A self has an identity and inward faculty that is straightened and completed; the sky likewise has a made form whose organized wholeness, not just material bulk, is being invoked.

activation_trace.role: Built form and constitution supply the focus-side concept carried into the analogy.
The thing itself or its identity supplies a constituted whole at the human scale.
The inward faculty of reason and awareness supplies an interior organization, not merely an outer body.
Straightness and completion in the thing itself supply the finishing operation that clarifies constitution.

structural_cues: 91:7 repeats the precise frame of 91:5: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا.
Sky, earth, and self form a descending scale while retaining the same maker-or-making construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax and branches of constitution, identity, inward faculty, and completion; I infer a scale analogy in which the self makes the kind of ordering in the sky intelligible. The alternative is formal parallelism without transfer of mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sky's constitution is only its external visible shape.
changed_reading.after: The sky's constitution is an organized whole analogous to a completed self: outer form expresses an ordered interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Constitution includes controlled thresholds. Inward intake is followed by two opposed tendencies: a breach that splits open and a protection that wards harm. Applied back to بَنَىٰ, building means designing passages, boundaries, and counter-capacities, not merely accumulating material.

activation_trace.role: Built constitution anchors the threshold model in the focus verb.
Swallowing and taking something fully inward supply an image of content entering a constituted interior.
A wide split and eruption supply the breaching or opening capacity.
Warding harm with protection supplies the opposed containing capacity.

structural_cues: 91:8 follows the self's fashioning with فَ and places two opposed objects inside the same pronominal self.
The focus verb بَنَىٰ and the later completion verb سَوَّىٰ both support a made-capacity reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward intake, splitting, protection, and the self's constitution; I infer an architectural arrow from those capacities back to the sky's building. The alternative is that the moral pair concerns only human choice and does not illuminate celestial construction.

changed_reading.before: Building gives a thing its stable form.
changed_reading.after: Building also equips a formed whole with regulated openings and protections, making capacity and boundary part of the sky's constitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weather-building baseline becomes a cultivation cycle. Rain marks land, the cultivator opens it, and growth increases; the opposed act pushes the life-bearing potential down into concealment. Building is therefore an ongoing choice between bringing form to growth and burying it.

activation_trace.role: Early rain marking the earth with vegetation supplies the visible beginning of cultivation.
Nourishment building flesh supplies growth as a genuine mode of construction.
The cultivator splitting earth supplies the opening action that lets marked growth develop.
Increase and growth supply the successful continuation of life-building.
Secret insertion and concealment supply the reversal in which potential growth is pushed out of sight.

structural_cues: 91:9 and 91:10 are balanced outcomes applied to the same feminine pronoun: زَكَّىٰهَا versus دَسَّىٰهَا.
The sky-earth-self progression lets rain, cultivation, and inward development remain distinct while sharing a growth mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-marked vegetation, flesh-building nourishment, ploughing, growth, and concealment; I infer a causal cultivation cycle linking them. The alternative is that agricultural imagery is only etymological coloring for human success and failure.

changed_reading.before: The sky builds life below through rain.
changed_reading.after: The sky initiates a cultivable life-process whose created potential can be opened into growth or actively buried.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rain-bearing sky is re-read as hydraulic order: construction holds and distributes water within measure. Overstepping appears materially as water rising into a sweeping excess, while a watering share and its channel represent apportioned flow.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky branch extends to cloud and rain, supplying the water-bearing reservoir.
Joined construction supplies containment and coordinated parts for ordered distribution.
Rising water and sweeping force materialize exceeded measure as overflow.
A share of irrigation and its channel supply measured allocation rather than unrestricted flow.

structural_cues: The narrative names transgressive excess before it names a protected watering allocation.
The earlier sky and spread earth provide the vertical and horizontal surfaces through which water can be contained and routed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain, construction, overflow, and an apportioned water-channel; I supply the arrow that celestial building is a system of hydrological measure mirrored by social limits. The alternative is that water is only an analogy inside طغيان and does not describe the sky.

changed_reading.before: The rain-bearing sky productively sends water downward.
changed_reading.after: The built sky also embodies measure: it contains and apportions life-bearing flow against the destructive possibility of overflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked sky becomes nonverbal testimony. A thing can 'say' through what it indicates, a messenger makes indication explicit, and denial shows that visible evidence still requires a reader. The built form functions like a message without collapsing into spoken words.

activation_trace.role: A sign read by discerning observation supplies the sky's capacity to be interpreted.
Constituted form supplies the organized medium that carries the indication.
Attributing a thing or speaker to falsehood supplies the possibility of refusing or discrediting evidence.
A thing's 'saying' as its indication supplies the bridge from visible form to nonverbal proposition.
Messenger and message supply the explicit communicative counterpart to the sky's implicit indication.

structural_cues: The surah moves from oath-objects to denial and then to an articulated warning.
The focus's visible object and active making clause already support an inference from artifact to maker before speech enters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a discernible sign, constituted form, denial, indication, and message; I infer that the oath presents the built sky as testimony. The live alternative is that only the messenger communicates and the sky remains a silent oath-object.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a readable identifying mark.
changed_reading.after: The sky's construction acts as evidence-bearing testimony whose indication can be discerned, articulated, or denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later divine naming and lordship pull one live hearing of وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا toward an agent who owns, nurtures, repairs, and completes. This sharpens agency without cancelling the coexisting masdariyya hearing, 'and its building.'

activation_trace.role: The active construction branch supplies the focus action whose subject remains grammatically open in مَا.
The worshipped deity branch supplies explicit divine naming later in the same sequence.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply a personal governing agent.
Repair, nurture, and completion recast building as continuing governance rather than a one-time fabrication.

structural_cues: The repeated وَمَا ... هَا clauses leave مَا available to agentive and eventive hearings.
91:13-14 later name ٱللَّهِ and رَبُّهُمْ explicitly, enabling but not requiring backward identification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an open مَا-construction, later divine names, sovereignty, and nurture; I infer a backward agentive sharpening of the builder. The materially live alternative is masdariyya مَا, in which the oath remains by the sky and its building rather than by a named builder.

changed_reading.before: The clause leaves 'what built it' and 'its building' unresolved.
changed_reading.after: One reading now hears a governing and completing agent behind the build, while the oath-by-building reading remains fully live beside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The physical support model acquires a social analogue. Message and a defined water share are load-bearing relations; hamstringing and cutting at the root attack those supports; eradication is the resulting collapse, while lordship names the authority that had nurtured and completed the order.

activation_trace.role: Ribs and house-posts supply the load-bearing schema transferred to communal relations.
Messenger and message supply an articulated rule that can support coordinated action.
The watering share and channel supply a concrete allocation around which the social structure is organized.
Cutting an animal's legs supplies the literal destruction of supports.
The root or foundation of a thing broadens the attack from a limb to structural origin.
Eradication supplies total collapse after the load-bearing relation is cut.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the constructive governance against which collapse is measured.

structural_cues: 91:13-14 form a tightly chained warning-allocation-rejection-cutting-eradication sequence.
The repeated فَ links refusal, support-cutting, and collapse as ordered events rather than a loose topic cluster.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a message, water allocation, severed legs, foundation, eradication, and nurturing lordship; I infer that these relations function like the supports of a built order. The alternative is that they remain narrative particulars with no backward analogy to celestial building.

changed_reading.before: The sky's supports are a purely material image of architectural stability.
changed_reading.after: The built sky also models relational stability: an order stands through honored supports and can collapse when its foundational allocations are cut.

context_deltas.mechanism: Making whole and making level coexist within the same ordering field. The self is completed; later, after eradication, the same root is applied again. This makes بَنَىٰ morally and materially non-sentimental: measured ordering can constitute differentiated form, while its punitive inverse can erase differentiation.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts supplies constructive differentiation as the starting operation.
Straightness and intrinsic completion supply ordering as formation.
Eradication supplies the destructive condition under which ordering changes valence.
Equality and equivalence supply the flattening possibility of making all distinctions level.

structural_cues: سَوَّىٰهَا occurs in 91:7 and returns as فَسَوَّىٰهَا in 91:14 after destructive action.
The repeated form binds initial constitution and terminal equalization without forcing them to have identical effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined construction, completed self-formation, eradication, and later equalization; I infer a reversible field of ordering in which making can articulate or level. The alternative is that the two سَوَّىٰ occurrences have unrelated objects and should not revise the sky's building.

changed_reading.before: Building is an unambiguously additive and stabilizing act.
changed_reading.after: Building belongs to a wider power of measured ordering whose other face can level a formed order after its supports fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked artifact can be viewed as an enduring aftermath of agency. The built sky is a visible remainder or footprint of an act, while the later sovereign agent is described in relation to fear and consequence. The reading shifts attention from the instant of building to what the act leaves standing behind it.

activation_trace.role: The visible identifying mark supplies the sky as a durable signature of an act.
Construction supplies the originating act whose remainder is under consideration.
Sovereign lordship supplies the agentive asymmetry behind both ordering and consequence.
Fear as anticipation of harm supplies the possibility of an agent recoiling from an act's result.
Remainder and trace supply the material persistence of what follows an act.

structural_cues: The final clause introduces fear of an aftermath after a sequence of making, warning, destruction, and equalization.
The focus itself places the built object before the building verb, foregrounding the standing result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible mark, an act of building, sovereignty, anticipated harm, and a residual trace; I infer that the sky can be perceived as the aftermath-signature of making. The alternative is that عُقْبَاهَا refers only to the immediately preceding destruction and has no bearing on the sky.

changed_reading.before: The sky is the direct product present at the completion of building.
changed_reading.after: The sky is also the lasting footprint of building, a visible consequence that continues to identify the scale and asymmetry of its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses architecture, animal anatomy, and archery. It remains anchored in explicit focus branches extending the sky-cover to an animal's upper back and building to a bow, ribs, and posts, then gains a concrete support-cutting analogue in the camel episode. Render it only as a material analogy for tension and support, never as a lexical claim that the sky is an animal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلسَّمَآءِ as upper cover and بَنَىٰ as tensioned, ribbed, supported construction.

activation_trace.role: The branch's extension from overhead sky to an animal's upper back permits an anatomical canopy image.
The bow pressing against its string supplies stored tension in a curved built form.
Ribs and posts supply the internal members that keep the tensioned form standing.
The camel's embodied form supplies the context-side organism on supports.
Hamstringing supplies the catastrophic result of cutting a load-bearing member.

changed_reading.before: The built sky resembles a rigid roof.
changed_reading.after: The built sky can be imagined as a curved body under tension, held by rib-like supports whose integrity is essential to the whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates idioms of bridal shelter and consummation inside a cosmic oath. It remains anchored in two ب ن ي branches and the focus sky-cover, with night-covering and pairedness as context support. Downstream prose should present it as a contained generative-enclosure analogy, not as a proposed direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sky is an overhead cover, while بَنَىٰ can evoke both a shelter and consummation under a bridal enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the enclosing cosmic chamber.
The hide dome or curtain-like shelter supplies the chamber's material form.
Consummation under the bridal shelter supplies generation as an event enabled by enclosure.
The intercourse branch of covering supplies a context-side convergence of enclosure and generation.
Pair and coupling supply the relational condition under which the generative chamber image coheres.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a protective shelter built over the world.
changed_reading.after: The sky can be carried as a generative enclosure: a covered chamber within whose patterned alternation life and pairing become possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it depends on the non-dominant و س م mapping of س م و. It remains valid as an activation because a marked season is explicitly packet-backed and the opening context supplies sun, moon, and succession. Render it as a calendrical affordance of the built sky, not as an etymology of سَمَاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of focus ٱلسَّمَآءِ activates a marked gathering season, while بَنَىٰ supplies organized construction.

activation_trace.role: The marked gathering season supplies calendrical and communal organization.
Construction by joining parts supplies an ordered celestial framework rather than an isolated time-marker.
The sun and its brightness supply one observable calendrical regulator.
The moon and its light supply a second observable regulator.
Following and succession turn the lights into a repeatable sequence.

changed_reading.before: The built sky is spatial architecture.
changed_reading.after: The built sky can also be temporal architecture, a visible calendar that marks seasons around which collective life can gather.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most branch-distant retained reading: it activates the focus root's hunting and rivalry branches and the moon root's hunting-by-moonlight branch. It remains anchored to both focus words through the sky as an organized arena, but downstream prose must label it a lexical-imagistic echo rather than an interpretation of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلسَّمَآءِ carries hunting and upward rivalry branches, while بَنَىٰ supplies the ordered field in which pursuit can unfold.

activation_trace.role: Going out to hunt supplies pursuit under the sky as a latent activity.
Rivaling by vying upward supplies contest within the elevated field.
Joined construction keeps the pursuit image anchored in an ordered arena rather than a free-floating hunting theme.
Hunting or setting out in moonlight supplies the context condition that activates the focus hunting branch.
Following supplies pursuit's directional sequence.

changed_reading.before: The sky's ordered cycles are passively observed.
changed_reading.after: At the far exploratory edge, the built sky becomes a nocturnal field that enables pursuit, following, and upward contest.

strongest_changes: The fixed roof became an operating light-envelope through the follow-reveal-cover sequence.
The paired spreading of earth made the sky the upper boundary of a coordinated habitat rather than an isolated edifice.
The repeated making syntax for the self turned building into constitution, capacity, and inward order.
Cultivation, bounded water, and support-cutting exposed productive, distributive, and destructive versions of the same making logic.
The split-root mark branches, later indication, and denial changed the built sky into readable but resistible testimony.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah generated unusually coherent crossings among architecture, embodiment, semiotics, weather, and social order. Most productive was the coexistence of dominant sky/build branches with non-dominant mark, visible-body, and rain-growth branches: context did not collapse them to one meaning but gave each a distinct mechanism.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative and masdariyya hearings of مَا remain live; later divine agency sharpens one without grammatically eliminating the other.
Readings using و س م and س م م are packet-authorized split-map activations but remain more form-distant than the dominant س م و inventory.
The early feminine pronouns permit a unified operational sequence, but their precise antecedential relations need not encode a single sky mechanism.
The transfer from cosmic construction to self, water allocation, and communal supports is abductive analogy, not an explicit causal statement in the packet.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sky as built upper cover, making creation architectural.** Lexical evidence: س م و B004 "overhead sky and cover"; ب ن ي B001 "building by joining parts"; ب ن ي B002 "built form and constitution." Structural cue: the ayah pairs the upper expanse with "what built it," followed by earth spread out and soul proportioned. Assigned role: سماء supplies vertical covering; بنى supplies constructed joining and constitution. Abductive move: I infer that the cosmic roof models a made order whose parts belong together; the packet supplies upper cover, building, earth spreading, and soul leveling. Reading change: the sky is not just an object sworn by but evidence of constructive composition, later mirrored in the soul's inward formation.

2. **Name/height resonance binds basmalah and sky.** Lexical evidence: س م و B005 "name as raised designation" in 91:0; س م و B001 "rising high" and B004 "overhead sky and cover" in 91:5; ء ل ه B002 fixed Allah-name. Structural cue: the same root occurs in `بسم` and `السماء`, one at the opening formula and one in the oath-chain. Assigned role: the root س م و bridges linguistic elevation and cosmic elevation. Abductive move: I supply the analogy that naming raises and the sky is raised; the packet supplies the repeated root and branch inventory. Reading change: the ayah makes the opening "name" spatially visible: divine designation and cosmic height activate one another.

3. **Building as kinship/filiation and generated belonging.** Lexical evidence: ب ن ي B007 "filiation and derived belonging"; ر ح م B002 "kinship bond"; ن ف س B011 "living soul-self" in 91:7. Structural cue: after "what built the sky," the packet moves through earth to a fashioned soul. Assigned role: بنى's sonship branch makes created structures belong to their source rather than merely being assembled artifacts. Abductive move: I infer a generated relation between builder and built thing; the packet supplies construction and filiation branches. Reading change: "what built it" can be heard as establishing dependence and belonging, preparing "naqat Allah" as a creature marked by divine belonging later.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later `ناقة الله` made ب ن ي B007 filiation/belonging feel less optional: built creation, named belonging, messenger of Allah, and she-camel of Allah all form a chain of derived dependence. 91:14 also changed "what built it" by contrast: divine building/proportioning is answered by divine re-leveling when the creature marked as belonging to Allah is cut down.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sky as an assembled system.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ن ي/B001` is building by joining parts; fixed `س م و/B004` is the overhead sky or upper cover. **Structural cue and role:** the constructed canopy follows four interlocking phases of light and darkness and precedes the spread earth, so building supplies relations and joints rather than a single inert mass. **Abductive move:** the coordinated phases and the verb of building are supplied; taking their fit as evidence of assembly is inferred. **Reading change:** `بناها` reads as integration of a working celestial order, not only erection of height.

2. **A macro-constitution that activates the self's constitution.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ب ن ي/B002` is built form or constitution; 91:7 `س و ي/B002` is internal straightness and sound completion. **Structural cue and role:** the parallel clauses `وما بناها`, `وما طحاها`, and `وما سواها` move from sky to ground to self, assigning constitution at each scale. **Abductive move:** the parallel grammar is explicit; treating the outer constructions as models for the self's structured capacity is inferred. **Reading change:** the sky-clause becomes the first stage of a nested architecture culminating in moral agency.

3. **A load-bearing cover that regulates visibility.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `س م و/B004` includes an upper covering surface and fixed `ب ن ي/B009` includes ribs, posts, and settled supports. **Structural cue and role:** the sky is both above the spread ground and the arena for alternation between manifestation and covering; the support image gives the canopy a stabilizing role. **Abductive move:** no supports are stated, so the move from `بناها` to an unseen load-bearing order is explicitly inferred from the construction relation. **Reading change:** the sky reads as a maintained enclosure that makes regulated exposure possible, not a decorative backdrop.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:6-7 completed the unexpected scale sequence: spread ground and proportioned self made `ب ن ي/B002` read as constitution, not only masonry. The divergent outcomes in 91:9-10 then showed why that constitution matters: an assembled capacity can be cultivated or concealed.

findings.text: Göğün kurulması, ışık ve karanlık evrelerini birbirine bağlayan işleyen bir bütünün birleştirilmesini anlatır; bu dış yapı, ileride canın iç yapısına örnek olur.
Açılıştaki adın yükseltilmesi ile göğün yüksekliği arasındaki bağ, ilahi belirlemeyi kozmik ölçekte görünür bir üst çerçeveye dönüştürür.
Kurma eyleminin soy ve aidiyet boyutu, yaratılmış düzeni kaynağına bağlı bir varlık olarak düşünmeye ve ilerideki Allah'ın devesi ifadesine hazırlık yapmaya elverir.
Göğün üst örtüsü, görünürlüğün düzenli dönüşümünü taşıyan görünmez desteklere sahip bir yapı gibi tasarlanabilir.
Kurucu düzen, surenin sonundaki cezalandırıcı düzleştirmeyle karşıtlık kurar: oluşturulan uyum, ağır ihlal karşısında yeniden düzene sokulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanların kutsal ziyaret veya pazar için toplandığı belirlenmiş zaman ve yeri, ayrıca böyle bir buluşmaya katılma eylemini verir. Dal çerçevesi belirlenmiş olma ile toplu buluşma ilişkisini doğru kurar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, belirlenmiş toplu buluşma zamanını ve yerini korur; kutsal ziyaret, pazar ve buluşmaya katılma kullanımları kendi yapılarıyla sınırlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların kutsal ziyaret, pazar veya benzeri ortak bir amaçla bir araya geldiği, önceden belirlenmiş zaman, yer ya da toplu buluşmadır. Bu belirlenmiş buluşmaya gidip katılmak da dala bağlı bir eylem olarak kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir zaman veya yer, insanların ortak amaçla toplanacağı belirlenmiş bir buluşma noktası işlevi görür.
Kutsal ziyaret için insanların toplandığı belirlenmiş buluşma bu çekirdeğin başlıca gerçekleşmesidir.
Eski Arap pazarlarının belirli toplanma zamanları ve yerleri de bu anlamın örnekleridir.
İnsanların belirlenmiş toplu buluşmaya gidip onu hazır bulunarak geçirmesi bağlantılı bir eylemdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, insanların bir araya geldiği belirlenmiş bir zamanın veya yerin toplu buluşmayı düzenlediğini vurgular. Kutsal ziyaret buluşması ve eski pazar toplantıları bunun örnekleridir; insanların bu buluşmaya katılması da aynı alanda ifade edilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir ev türünden daha geniştir: çadırımsı örtü, perde, deri yaygı, hasır ve saklama kabı gibi ayrı nesneleri aynı ad çevresinde sıralar. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bu nesne dizisini yalnızca ev ya da örtü diye daraltmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel ad biçimlerini kapsar ve bunları yalın kurma anlamına genellemez; kökeni tartışmalı oturuş anlatımı yalnızca ayrı sözlük biriminde kalır.

concept_map.definition: Deri veya benzeri malzemeden yapılan çadırımsı örtü, perde, yaygı, hasır ya da saklama kabı için kullanılan nesne adıdır. Bir başka kullanımda yağmurdan korunmak veya yere sermek üzere açılan yaygıyı belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir evi örten veya çadırımsı biçim oluşturan deri örtü ya da perde.
Deri ya da benzeri malzemeden yaygı, hasır veya saklama kabı olarak kullanılan nesne.
Yağmurdan korunmak, namaz kılmak veya malı sergilemek için yere serilen yaygı.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çadırımsı deri örtüden yaygı, hasır ve saklama kabına uzanan bir nesne dizisi verir; ayrıca yere serilen yaygı kullanımını bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yayın kirişine olağandışı ölçüde yapışmasını ve kirişin kopma noktasına yaklaşmasını kusur olarak açıkça tanımlar. Bölgesel biçim aynı kusurlu yay adının değişkesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yay ve kirişten oluşan özel söz öbeğine ve onun bölgesel biçimine bağlı tutulur; yalın bir yapışma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kirişine aşırı ölçüde yaklaşarak yapışmış ve bu yüzden kirişi kopma tehlikesine sokmuş kusurlu yaydır.

facets.statement: Yayın gövdesinin kendi kirişine olağandışı ölçüde yaklaşması ve yapışması.
Bu temasın kirişi neredeyse koparacak kadar güçlü olması ve bir yay kusuru sayılması.
Aynı kusurlu yay için belirli bir toplulukta kullanılan farklı biçim.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yayın kirişine yapışmasını ve kirişin kopma tehlikesini aynı kusurun öğeleri olarak verir; ayrıca bölgesel bir biçim bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geçerli söz öbeğini gelini götürme ve eşle birleşme anlamlarıyla açıklar, bunu yapan erkek için de bir ad verir. Aynı kanıt, başka bir ilgeçle kurulan yaygın biçimi kaynak dilin yerleşik kullanımı dışında sayarak sınırı açıkça çizer.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtlanan söz öbeği ve ona bağlı kişi adıyla sınırlıdır; reddedilen ilgeçli biçim veya genel yapı anlamı buraya alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gelini yeni evine götürmek veya erkeğin düğün gecesi eşiyle birleşmesidir; bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek için de kullanılan bir adı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gelinin yeni evine götürülmesi ve erkeğin düğün gecesi eşiyle birleşmesi.
Düğün gecesinde eşler için bir çadır kurulmasıyla açıklanan geleneksel bağlantı.
Bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek için kullanılan damat adı.
Başka bir ilgeçle kurulan yaygın biçimin yerleşik kaynak dil kullanımı dışında sayılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelini götürme ile eşle birleşme anlamlarını, bunlarla ilgili damat adını ve alternatif ilgeçli biçime yönelik açık kullanım sınırını birlikte verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gerçek oğul-kız bağını, birini oğul edinmeyi ve bir kaynaktan çıkma, yetiştirilme, hizmet veya sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle aktarılan adlandırmaları birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak gerçek soy ile aktarılmış bağlılık aynı ilişkiymiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çocuk ve çocukluk bağı biçimleriyle, edinme eylemini ve belirli bağlılık söz öbeklerini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak soy bağıyla bağlı olması ve bu bağın adıdır. Birini oğul edinmeye, oğulluğunu ileri sürmeye ve bir kaynaktan çıkma, onun tarafından yetiştirilme ya da ona sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla anılmaya da uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak anne babasıyla taşıdığı gerçek çocukluk ve soy bağı.
Bir kişiyi oğul edinme veya onun oğulluğunu ileri sürme.
Bir şeyden çıkma veya onun tarafından yetiştirilme nedeniyle çocuk adıyla kurulan aktarılmış bağ.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

source_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

tier_contracts.explicit_interest: Full source branch payload, except fields removed from all tiers.
tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
